parameters.query: INSERT INTO notifications (posting_id, channel) VALUES ($1, 'discord') ON CONFLICT (posting_id, channel) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, posting_id, $2::text AS company, $3::text AS role, $4::text AS location, $5::text AS employment_type, $6::text AS apply_url, $7::integer AS match_score, $8::text AS reason, $9::text AS missing_skills_text, $10::text AS deadline, $11::text AS eligibility, $12::text AS ctc_or_stipend
INSERT INTO runs (workflow, started_at, finished_at, notified) VALUES ('WF-3', now(), now(), $1) RETURNING id
